title: Emil Zátopek's birth chart
metaDescription: Emil Zátopek's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 25.7° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, Mercury holds a conjunction to Jupiter at 0.0° — close enough to weld thinking to expansion. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At the noon reference the Sun sits 25.7° into Virgo — the third decan, which the old scheme hands to Venus. Same sign, different decan, different chart.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 22.0° Libra; Venus stands at 12.0° Scorpio; Mars stands at 3.3° Capricorn. The tradition reads thought that travels by comparison from Mercury, attraction that works by atmosphere from Venus, effort banked steadily until it tells from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The tightest geometry in the chart puts Mercury in the same degree of the zodiac from Jupiter, 0.0° off exact. A conjunction is the least negotiable aspect in the scheme — no distance to argue across, so the pair arrives as a single instinct. Behind it, Uranus trine Pluto at 0.1°, and Venus trine Pluto at 0.9° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Venus, Uranus, Pluto close a triangle of trines. Three trines close into a circuit the tradition calls a grand trine — ease so complete it can idle unnoticed for years. The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks three placements here. Venus in Scorpio at 12.0° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Mars in Capricorn at 3.3° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Saturn in Libra at 8.8° is in exaltation. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Counting only the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the chart runs 3 air, 3 water, 2 earth, 1 fire by element and 5 cardinal, 2 mutable, 2 fixed by modality. Air runs on comparison and connection — the pattern noticed first, the feeling filed second. Uranus was retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Leo into Virgo during that day at the birthplace, travelling 15.0° between one midnight and the next. Half the day belongs to each sign, and the split falls at an unrecorded hour — so this page holds the Moon as a genuine unknown.
